(:begin
  [:set! ?s0 [:scanner-open "VAET"]]
  [:set! ?s1 [:scanner-open "VAET"]]
  [:set! ?s2 [:scanner-open "AEVT"]]
  [:set! ?s3 [:scanner-open "VAET"]]
  [:set! ?it_emp [:scanner-iterate-init ?s0 []]]
  (:while
    [:set! emp [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_emp]]
    (:begin
      [:scanner-push ?s0 emp]
      [:set! ?it_m [:scanner-iterate-init ?s1 []]]
      (:while
        [:set! m [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_m]]
        (:begin
          [:scanner-push ?s1 m]
          [:set! ?it_nat [:scanner-iterate-init ?s3 []]]
          (:while
            [:set! nat [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_nat]]
            (:begin
              [:scanner-push ?s3 nat]
              [:scanner-push ?s0 [:intern-a "estab/empresa"]]
              [:scanner-push ?s1 [:intern-a "estab/municipio"]]
              [:scanner-push ?s2 [:intern-a "empresa/razao_social"]]
              [:scanner-push ?s3 [:intern-a "empresa/natureza_juridica"]]
              [:set! ?it_e [:scanner-iterate-init ?s0 ?s1 ?s2 ?s3 []]]
              (:while
                [:set! e [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_e]]
                (:begin
                  [:scanner-push ?s0 e]
                  [:scanner-push ?s1 e]
                  [:scanner-push ?s2 e]
                  [:scanner-push ?s3 e]
                  [:set! ?it_rs [:scanner-iterate-init ?s2 []]]
                  (:while
                    [:set! rs [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_rs]]
                    [:begin [:result-row [:resolve-val emp] [:resolve-val m]]])
                  [:scanner-pop ?s0]
                  [:scanner-pop ?s1]
                  [:scanner-pop ?s2]
                  [:scanner-pop ?s3]))
              [:scanner-pop ?s3]
              [:scanner-pop ?s2]
              [:scanner-pop ?s1]
              [:scanner-pop ?s0]
              [:scanner-pop ?s3]))
          [:scanner-pop ?s1]))
      [:scanner-pop ?s0])))
